Meet Rohan, a 30-year-old entrepreneur living a lavish lifestyle, but barely scraping by. His story reveals the difference between looking rich and actually being wealthy, highlighting the importance of financial stability and strategic investments. The video explores the concept of wealth creation, discussing how to build lasting wealth and addressing the wealth disparity in India.
